description: This file contains unit tests for the WebAudioPlayerTaskFactory class, which creates various tasks related to Web Audio Player functionality in the Rialto project. It uses Google Test framework to verify the creation of different task objects such as SetCaps, Play, Pause, Eos, Stop, Shutdown, SetVolume, WriteBuffer, and HandleBusMessage.

classes.name: WebAudioPlayerTaskFactoryTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for WebAudioPlayerTaskFactory, setting up mocks and context for each test.

methods.name: ShouldCreateSetCaps
methods.description: Tests creation of SetCaps task with specific MIME type and configuration.

methods.name: ShouldCreateEos
methods.description: Tests creation of End Of Stream (Eos) task.

methods.name: ShouldWriteBuffer
methods.description: Tests creation of WriteBuffer task with buffer pointers.

methods.name: ShouldHandleBusMessage
methods.description: Tests creation of HandleBusMessage task with a GstMessage.
